answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can submit work, then slash that stake when independent audits show it copied outputs or coordinated to claim the same reward. Auditors can compare signed task histories, so spinning up identities does not create independent evidence. A cipher can protect private details in those records; juniper and wharf might be harmless task labels. The attacker must lock real capital in each identity and risks losing it, making a Sybil swarm costly rather than free.
